summary.text: Liz Miranda is a Democratic state senator who has represented the 2nd Suffolk District since 2023 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives, representing the 5th Suffolk District from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Liz Miranda earned a B.A. in Africana studies and urban studies from Wellesley College in 2002.
Her career experience includes serving as principal of Miranda & Co. Consulting Group, executive director of the Hawthorne Youth and Community Center, and co-president of Score4More, Inc.
She has served on the board of Union Capital Boston and as a mentor with the Dudley Street Neighborhood Initiative.
Miranda succeeded Evandro Carvalho in the state House in 2019 and moved to the Senate in 2023.

Her 2025-2026 committee assignments include chair of the Joint Committee on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, vice chair of the Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities Joint Committee, and membership on the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
